$comment: HOLLOW SUN visual art (Game Design Bible D34): UI, icons, portraits and menu art from Scenario. Workflow: (1) generate the style board with a base model, keep the best 15-25 images, (2) train two custom style models in Scenario (HS UI, HS Icons) on them and put their ids under models, (3) generate the sets, (4) pick, clean up and export into the game. Never name living artists, other games or brands in a prompt (D32/D34). Record plan and date under recorded.

recorded.via: Scenario MCP, team Caldrjir's Organization, Default Project

style: hand-painted dark fantasy game art, aged bronze and blackened iron, soot and ash, warm ember glow from below, cold pale eclipse light from above, worn leather and cracked parchment, painterly brush texture with crisp readable silhouettes, muted desaturated palette of charcoal, ash grey and bronze with ember orange accents, high detail, premium AAA quality
avoid: text, letters, watermark, signature, logo, photo, 3d render look, plastic, neon colours, bright saturated colours, cartoon, anime, blurry, low detail, cropped
